scope: Actual sealed selection and held pending v2 metadata, prepare/release/freeze, guarded collector/runner resource and identity boundaries; no execution.

entry_checks.prepare: Requires separate heldout and heldout_initialization_replacements released scopes; actual completed selection required; exact scientific contract and exact pending/CPU/code binding required.
entry_checks.freeze: Actual selection complete.json and explicit result.json references must appear in freeze; runner requires both. Recursive authorization original/snapshot inventory is checked before execution. Growing ledger/registry is not frozen.
entry_checks.selection: Sealed A4000 four members + fixed matched-post; exact scientific parameters equal pending v2; held cannot select method or gate again.
entry_checks.collector: create_heldout_collector validates release, registered cases and A4000 identity before engine creation; verifies loaded member paths/hashes. _bank checks same-source raw a0/noise/mask/full direction matching before branches.
entry_checks.identity: Original 100 held slots, 20/task, plus exactly 200 ordered same-task backups; inherited whole replacement mapping is narrowed to these 300 cases in actual validation and ledger.
entry_checks.initial_states: assert_uninitialized is metadata-only. Actual physical uniqueness is checked through original pre-action scene/resolution path during authorized capture; no physical uniqueness is claimed from uninitialized metadata.
entry_checks.resources: heldout stage 2200 simulator attempts, 0 optimizer; technical_reserve existing shared 1200 with heldout_initialization_replacements scope. Ledger accepts only one simulator reservation and registered capture/bank/five-arm repeat_0..3 identities. Updates and other phases rejected.
entry_checks.run: 100 planned logical sources x four paired suffixes; five physical arms; native10 first alarm, original seeds and raw semantics; complete velocity/direct/post/reverse/random matching dependencies retained.
entry_checks.global_acceptance: Inherited replicates=2 records calibration selection provenance only; actual held source/branch replication and statistics are 4. Fixed post choice and selection_after_heldout_allowed=false prevent re-running sign selection.
entry_checks.statistics: Unique primary post_minus_alarm_replan10; source denominator 100, four within-source paired repeats, original fixed bootstrap ordering; six other comparisons secondary. No-cut common outcomes retained; missing never filled with zero.
entry_checks.lifecycle: 32 workers, eight GPUs, four workers/GPU; launch calls gpu_occupancy_lifecycle.sh run for entire wave with hold_idle=false. Workers require lifecycle. On return write audit-required status, no retry/new stage/method selection; normal lifecycle exit restores holders.

evidence_limits.CPU_evidence: Previously reviewed 75 integration + 17 statistics reused; no repeats.
evidence_limits.condition: Root must publish exact held READY, then executor create/verify independent actual freeze. This review is not itself execution authorization.
